validation: Batch 01 local full suite passed; Windows CI pending.

improvements.description: Windows hardware discovery no longer starts PowerShell. Native DXGI enumerates NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and other hardware; preserves full pointer-width dedicated VRAM; excludes software adapters by their documented flag; and retains hardware with no dedicated VRAM.
One unusable CUDA device no longer hides healthy devices.
Cached CUDA selection is applied to the thread that actually performs the work.
Windows cannot select an arbitrary `nvidia-smi` executable from PATH, the working directory, or environment-overridden install roots.
NVIDIA metadata cannot be assigned to a different GPU whose model merely shares a prefix.
Two physical adapters with the same model are retained when NVIDIA's utility is unavailable.
Missing NVIDIA fields do not erase useful native metadata.
Malformed NVIDIA CSV or nonfinite/fractional indices cannot crash discovery or select the wrong device.
A full Windows GPU refresh performs one native enumeration.
Refreshing NVIDIA information invalidates an older universal GPU snapshot.
CUDA fused kernels receive scalars with the widths declared by their C signatures.
Retrying a failed accuracy-scoring tile does not count pixels or brush hits twice.
Very dark byte palettes produce correct Oklab distances.
Damaged hardware profiles become recoverable cache misses instead of uncaught exceptions.
Explicit empty preference data is respected, and malformed nested preferences safely select CPU.
Nonfinite benchmark values cannot win backend selection or create infinite speedups.
Suggested GPU memory budgets respect currently reported free memory.
CPU-name fallback does not perform unnecessary WMI/platform queries.
Reading optional runtime versions does not initialize CUDA/OpenCL DLLs.
Auto backend status follows measured crossover thresholds and current backend health.
Cancellation is responsive during a single long stroke.
Programmatic GPU installers verify the actual target virtual environment before modifying packages.
Process start failures and timeouts return controlled setup results with CPU fallback.
OpenCL validation uses the selected Python interpreter before and after installation.
A broken first OpenCL adapter no longer hides another working GPU.

Windows OS DLLs used by DPI, taskbar and shared native helpers load with `LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32` before PyInstaller can rewrite a bare filename into the bundle. OS directory discovery uses Windows APIs rather than environment variables.
Failure to load the Windows DPI provider returns a safe 96-DPI default instead of aborting target inspection.
Taskbar properties reject a null COM store, avoid dereferencing null text and clear allocated PROPVARIANT output even when `GetValue` fails.
A diagnostics ZIP appears at its final path only after collection and ZIP closure succeed; interrupted collection removes the temporary archive.
Settings and calibration collection limits each JSON input to 4 MiB and each summary to 100 files, preventing unbounded exports from corrupted local state.
Diagnostics omit linked settings, calibration files and logs, including linked parent directories and Windows junctions.
Diagnostics include the consolidated debug-error log and its rotated copy, with the same redaction as other exported logs.
Calibration version metadata cannot copy an arbitrary nested object into an otherwise summarized export; string versions are sanitized and limited.
Cookie and Set-Cookie headers are redacted in plain logs and quoted JSON fields.
Shared logs redact common Windows user paths on drives other than C, plus Linux and macOS home paths. Missing home-directory lookup does not disable other redaction.
Non-finite numeric context is omitted so diagnostics metadata remains valid strict JSON.
Python-generated session, error and exception records redact credentials before writing them locally. Export sanitization remains a second boundary.
Individual application log records are limited to 64 Ki characters after sanitization; rotation considers the incoming record size.
Direct worker-error writes, log rotation and Python exception-stream writes share the reentrant log lock.
Runtime ZIP validation rejects traversal, absolute paths, unexpected roots, alternate data streams, reserved Windows names and trailing-dot/space aliases.
Runtime ZIP validation rejects duplicate paths under Windows case/separator rules and file-versus-directory collisions.
Runtime ZIP validation rejects symbolic links and special-file metadata.
Release build and validation inspect only the two-byte executable header instead of reading whole EXEs into memory. Hashing and CRC validation continue to stream complete content.
Checksum validation accepts only safe unique basenames and verifies exact coverage of the selected standard/CUDA release artifacts.
Manifest validation rejects malformed roots/rows, duplicate or unexpected artifacts, unsafe names, boolean schema values and non-integer sizes; generator inputs are fully verified.

Source archive creation preserves a previous archive on failure and atomically replaces it on success. The destination is excluded even through a `..` path; an output symlink is replaced without changing its target.
Under the same Python/zlib build, identical source contents produce identical ZIP bytes with fixed source-entry timestamps and permissions, independent of checkout mtimes and umask.
Source archives do not follow file/directory links or Windows junctions; runtime privacy exclusions also apply to Windows case variants.
Isolated target results reject boolean/invalid native IDs, invalid or empty rectangles and inconsistent DPI scaling. An explicit HWND probe must return that same window.

LocalDumps setup/restoration validates the complete saved configuration and all planned originals before any registry mutation. A changed later target can no longer leave an earlier target partially configured.

`SessionRecovery._safe_primitive` previously retained NaN and infinities. Saving drops nonfinite option values, and loading rejects nonfinite JSON numbers. Valid integers, booleans, and bounded strings remain supported.

Python equality allowed boolean/float recovery schemas and truthiness accepted strings such as `"false"` for `has_image`. Schema IDs now require an integer, and the image flag requires a boolean. Legacy absent image flags still mean false.

Session and render JSON previously used unbounded `read_text`. Reads are now limited to 128 KiB and 8 MiB respectively, with depth/item limits and safe handling of invalid UTF-8, decoder recursion, and nonfinite numbers. A broken render file still permits a valid session to load.

Saving and loading used different canvas-coordinate validation, and coercing infinity could raise `OverflowError`. Both paths now use one validator for exactly two pairs of integer coordinates within ±200,000, without silently truncating floats or accepting booleans.

Target-lock hints copied arbitrary nested lists and unbounded scalar values. Only known metadata fields are retained with explicit shapes, lengths, numeric limits, and types. Live handles and authorization remain excluded.

A fixed PNG temporary filename and separately replaced image/state could mix concurrent saves or change the previous snapshot's pixels after a state-write failure. New schema 3 publishes uniquely staged, SHA-256-addressed images before the state file. A thread lock and OS advisory lock serialize publication and cleanup. Successful saves retain the current and previous image generations; failed publication preserves the current snapshot.

Cached images previously decoded without a size gate. Loading now limits encoded bytes to 256 MiB and dimensions to 40 million pixels, treats Pillow decompression warnings as rejection, and verifies a new snapshot's image digest using the same open file that is decoded. The pixel limit preserves the existing screenshot-capture ceiling.

The recovery allowlist discarded existing snapshot fields, including resource scheduling, detail zoom, visual verification, color fidelity, profile/edge behavior, sketch detail, timer reading, and render preset. These fields now survive save/load without allowing input authorization or automatic preview restoration.
`clear_render_resume` deleted progress before the session write succeeded. It now clears progress only after the new state file publishes successfully.

Sequence checkpoints treated valid `color_index=0` as missing because of `or -1`. Zero now remains zero through checkpoint validation and resolution; absent/None color indices retain the missing-value sentinel.
A checkpoint could claim both path-level and sequence-level progress, and validation silently chose one. Contradictory modes now invalidate the checkpoint.

Sequence bit validation expanded every bit into a Python boolean list. Validation and count reconstruction now use packed bytes, enforce encoded length and zero tail bits, and cap the operation count before allocation. The existing `_decode_bits` compatibility helper remains available.

Custom profile names could collide by case or contain control/format characters. Creation, loading, and portable-profile validation now use printable, bounded names, and new registrations enforce casefold uniqueness while retaining ordinary Unicode names.
Two registry names could reuse one custom UUID and therefore share settings/calibration storage. Loading now records existing key owners and ignores a second owner of the same key.

The custom profile registry was an unbounded UTF-8 read. Loading now caps bytes and entries, rejects duplicate JSON keys, safely handles invalid UTF-8/decoder recursion, and only registers valid flat name/key pairs.

Importing profile settings and calibrations sequentially could leave a partially replaced profile. All new files are staged before publication, originals are retained as unique backups, and a reported write/move/delete failure restores prior files, including prior absence. A failed rollback retains recovery files and reports their paths.

Import-as-copy and new imported profiles registered a UI entry before their files were saved. Registry publication is now included in the file operation, and in-memory registration happens only after all profile files and the registry succeed.
Reset profile deleted files one at a time and could stop with half the original profile missing. Reset now uses the same backup/rollback mechanism, and does not reload defaults when a deletion fails.

App-tool and exact-color filenames used a different sanitizer from other profile files, causing collisions such as `a/b` and `a-b`. Both now use `ProfileStorage.safe_profile_key`; ordinary built-in/custom UUID filenames remain unchanged.

Integral floating factors such as `2.0` passed validation but produced floating resize dimensions, while size suggestions accepted dimensions rejected by actual upscaling. Upscale calculations now normalize supported numeric factors to integers and share strict positive-integer dimension validation with suggestions.

Corner color previously used exactly the Auto border model. It now samples small patches at the four actual corners and uses the dominant corner-color cluster. Full-border Auto modeling remains unchanged. Border connectivity, transparency preservation, and destructive-removal guards still apply.

Background removal checked cancellation only after EXIF/RGBA allocation and could return a result after cancellation during final alpha work. It now checks before allocation, before segmentation, and at every result-return boundary, including preservation branches.
Profile reset discarded `one_click_setup_after` without cancelling its Tk callback. It now cancels the old profile's pending setup callback before clearing its token and payload.

Scheduling a recovery checkpoint cancelled unrelated preview, setup, profile, capture, and drawing timers. `DrawBotApp._schedule_recovery_checkpoint` now reschedules only its own recovery timer and preserves image-request coalescing.

Recovery loaded a cached image unconditionally, ignoring the snapshot's image flag and identity. `DrawBotApp._apply_recovery_snapshot` now requires `has_image is True` and passes `image_sha256` to the loader. The recovered UI remains disarmed.
Stop can cancel a release check before a request or between metadata chunks; cancellation remains distinct from a network error.

Release checks enforce a 30-second elapsed-time budget between redirects and response chunks, in addition to socket timeouts. An active socket read remains subject to its read timeout; this is not a hard wall-clock interruption.
Version parsing accepts either `v` or `V` consistently and rejects ambiguous non-ASCII numeral tags.
Release-page links are constructed for the selected tag in this repository instead of trusting an arbitrary `html_url`.
An installer asset still being uploaded is not offered as a completed update.
Installer handoff validates metadata again and holds a Windows read handle that denies writes and deletion while hashing and starting the verified file.
Update downloads check available disk space before a network request or partial-file creation and explain how much space is required.
Binary downloads request unencoded bytes and reject unexpected content encoding or a conflicting Content-Length before reading the body.
GitHub rate-limit failures explain the limit and Retry-After delay, and retain the Releases-page alternative.
A slower, older mobile-preview encode cannot replace a newer frame within the same session.
Unchanged mobile image content keeps its revision, avoiding repeated image reloads on phones.
The opt-in preview server caps concurrent clients at 12 instead of creating unbounded request threads.
Idle or stalled preview clients have a five-second socket timeout, freeing workers and bounding slow writes.
Failure to start the preview server thread closes its socket and rolls back the published session state.
LAN discovery runs outside the image/state lock; cached addresses refresh when the sharing panel is reopened, and Stop cancels an in-progress start.
Advertised preview addresses are valid allowed IPv4 LAN addresses, deduplicated and sorted numerically; unusable public/IPv6 strings are omitted.
The phone page aborts stalled status requests, handles HTTP errors, hides stale images on disconnect and retries a failed image even when the frame revision has not changed.
The phone page uses image availability to show an empty state without requesting missing images, and gives the selected view and image accessible labels.
Invalid or non-finite wheel deltas no longer poison accumulated fractional scroll motion.
Wheel input at the end of an inner panel can scroll its enclosing panel.
Tree views, combo boxes, spin boxes, sliders and Shift-wheel retain their native input bindings.
macOS source runs interpret native wheel units without incorrectly dividing them by Windows' 120-unit scale.
Cancellation prevents recovery input after a failed transaction, is never retried as a transient exception, and is checked again before accepting a successful operation.
Invalid, NaN and infinite pacing parameters are rejected before they can reach UI waits.
Paint and its readable UI Automation PowerShell helper resolve their executable paths through the Windows API instead of trusting environment directory overrides.
A cached numeric, spectrum or eyedropper method could be selected after its required controls, keyboard backend or sample became unavailable.
Creating a tiny probe copied an entire smart path and another slice before using its first distinct segment.
Worker palette matching used the global palette's length rather than the supplied palette. An exact match at index 23 could be ignored when the global palette contained 18 colors.
With Skip white disabled, CPU color planning turned fully transparent source pixels into white strokes. The accelerated path already left them undrawn.
Scalar RGB-nearest matching still applied perceptual fidelity penalties, so it could disagree with the universal CPU/CUDA/OpenCL score definition.
Serial color planning rebuilt the same palette and names for every pixel.
Basic serial planning unpacked four channels directly from the supplied image and crashed on ordinary RGB, grayscale and palette-mode images.
Rounding both fitted dimensions upward could exceed `prepare_image`'s hard pixel budget, including on thin panoramas.
Standard image preparation could continue converting/resizing an already cancelled image or return a result after Stop arrived during resize.
Reloading `palette.json` changed RGB values but left the nearest-color cache keyed to the previous palette.

Accuracy evaluation flattened source transparency but discarded preview alpha, treating hidden black pixels as visible black. A same-size cached source in grayscale/RGBA could also fail shape validation.
Importance maps were quantized to 8 bits even at their original size. A value of 0.62 became approximately 0.6196 and fell below the important-feature threshold.
NaN coverage could be clamped into a displayed 100% score; nonfinite execution scores had the same problem.
Stop arriving during late summary/heatmap work did not prevent publication of the completed accuracy result.
The delta-error heatmap retained a full RGB float staging image before copying it into RGB bytes.
General numeric RGB APIs inferred scale only from the brightest value, interpreting integer RGB(1,1,1) as normalized white.
An empty pairwise palette produced an indexing exception.
Forced-CUDA routing could crash on malformed stored throughput or select infinite/nonpositive benchmark values.
Negative OpenCL indices selected devices from the end of Python lists; malformed CUDA IDs could silently become device zero.
Several numeric GPU paths caught cancellation as a backend failure and retried on CPU. Completed work could also escape a late Stop, and the advanced color caller did not forward its callback.
Backend-health mutation and snapshot iteration were unsynchronized.
CPU palette matching repeated OKLab/features for each tile pair and allocated a pixel×palette×RGB difference cube.
Picture-palette cache loading read the entire file and allowed parser recursion failures to escape.
Cache validation coerced invalid schema/dimensions/RGB values, accepted inconsistent color groups, and converted nonfinite coverage into plausible values.
Saving an invalid palette could replace an existing valid cache with data that should never be trusted.
The image cache key hashed a 512-pixel thumbnail, so visible source edits could disappear during resampling and reuse an old palette.
A cancelled palette request could still hash the image, return a cache hit or continue edge-color sampling.
Failure to access or write the optional cache could prevent a valid in-memory picture palette from being used; lookup also created an empty directory.
Already-opaque RGB images were converted through RGBA, and analysis helpers copied newly owned RGB images again.
Region measurement scanned the full label image separately for every color.
Region measurement computed median and low/high percentiles in separate passes.
Source-backed representative selection repeatedly normalized the same target and computed Python scalar distances for every candidate.
Adaptive selection could keep two colors despite an explicit one-color maximum.
Adaptive palette analysis repeated symmetric CIEDE2000 comparisons and recomputed the same candidate pair costs across trials.
GPU importance normalization lacked the CPU fallback for collapsed percentile ranges, yielding different sparse/flat maps.
Importance analysis read hidden RGB values from transparent pixels, creating detail that the user would not see.
A 128 MiB floor could override a small explicit importance-map VRAM budget, and malformed budget values could abort analysis.
Importance analysis could return a CPU/GPU result after Stop; a GPU interruption could be swallowed as ordinary fallback.
Preset swatch detection retained a tuple for every component pixel solely to calculate its size and bounding box later.
Every refinement-quality check expanded weighted color errors back into one entry per sampled pixel.
A path cap of zero or two could retain four paths, one for each selected color.
Progressive execution sampling ignored the requested color cap; eight colors survived a cap of two.
Endpoint/midpoint sampling missed a protected third pixel in a four-pixel micro-stroke.
Removing empty paths before aligning metadata shifted outline phase hints and protected prefixes to later tone paths.
A block-local reorder passed its transition check while global color/brush changes rose from one to three.
A NaN elapsed sample recorded an 80 paths/sec estimate and invalid accumulated seconds. Corrupt profiles contaminated later estimates.
Counting ordinary moves constructed and retained the complete coordinate path.
Each run rescanned active paths whose sorted intervals had already ended.
A malformed explicitly supplied contour collapsed to the same value as an absent legacy contour and skipped checks.
Malformed or reversed exact row spans could be discarded into a permissive bounding-box fallback.
A seed outside its intended region was accepted if it lay inside the overall canvas.
Exact graph/neighbor merges reversed directed paths even with `allow_reverse=False`.
Collinear compression erased direction reversals and their painted excursion.
A 1,200-point alternating contour exceeded Python's recursion limit during RDP simplification.
Adjacent-pair testing split a later short run nested inside an earlier long run into a new component.
Component mass counted duplicate/overlapping source runs repeatedly.
Component detection compared every previous-row run with every current-row run.
Bounded nearest-neighbor search still shifted the entire future job on each list removal.
The last-resort palette fallback allocated a row-count × full-width × palette tensor, so very wide rows defeated the row bound.
A NaN missing-pixel tolerance approved a fixture missing 75% of its intended coverage.
Pre-cancelled work still allocated canvas masks; a very long contour outside the canvas had no bounded cancellation point.
A 160-pixel style thumbnail required full-resolution RGBA conversion and another full copy first.
Phase, importance, and spatial seeding repeatedly scanned the same path for length, bounds, and center.
Missing optional shadow maps allocated and summed two zero arrays for every raster run.

A negative drawable index selected the last palette color in dot mode, while line mode silently discarded it; malformed shapes were unchecked. Unsigned indices also failed when constructing a negative sentinel.
Pre-cancelled Off/small-image paths still converted the image, and cancellation during the final composite published a result.
Taking eight representative items first copied every entry in an already-indexable sequence.
`max(2, ...)` prevented the below-2 exit from ever enforcing the advertised analysis-size ceiling.
Nonmaximum suppression sorted all eligible cells into Python tuples before selecting at most twice the small path cap.
Empty geometry became billable dots or caused palette/brush state changes despite executing no stroke.
An explicit brush change followed by a stroke omitting brush metadata implicitly switched back to the default, charging a second switch.
Each orientation computed both candidate order costs, then recomputed the chosen cost.
Detail strokes chose the smallest nominal brush, even when only larger sizes had verified controls.
Repeated color-order entries overwrote a group's sample but incremented path totals repeatedly.
Every shared-endpoint join rescanned all already-used indices, producing quadratic behavior for repeated endpoints.
Dense-component density analysis built exact vertical runs, then vertical candidate generation built them again.
Portrait preparation ignored cancellation through most non-preview processing, including CPU contrast, subject lifting, and saliency loops.
GPU analysis sessions were released only after normal line-mode completion; dot returns and exceptions skipped cleanup. Preparation also had no explicit owner when metadata was omitted.
Weighted int16 luminance overflow made white evaluate as −1 instead of 255, suppressing a black/white edge.
A single connected component could flood for its full size before checking cancellation; source-size rejection happened after conversion.
`atomic_write_text` ignored every `fsync` failure and could replace good state after a real disk error.
Tool calibrations and scheduler saves skipped durable flushing; the performance tuner reused one staging filename; release metadata was written in place.
Several local state readers loaded arbitrary file sizes and accepted ambiguous duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers or excessive nesting.
Atomic replacement did not prevent two learning writers from reading the same old database and losing one update. Resets and migrations could race with writes.
A profile key limited to 80 Unicode characters could still exceed a filesystem component's encoded-byte limit once its filename prefix was added.
Boolean/fractional schema values passed equality/coercion checks; a list/string in exact-color `controls` could raise `AttributeError` during availability checks.
Exact-color points accepted arbitrarily large integers even though normal tool calibration already bounded positions.
Degenerate/inverted spectrum rectangles and coincident brightness endpoints could be advertised as usable custom-color calibration.
Numeric-only custom-color capability probing loaded and validated the same file twice; a concurrent replacement could also produce inconsistent observations.
Corrupt timing sample counts, ratios or runtime containers could crash estimation or prevent future good samples from being recorded.
Invalid operation counters or `last_average_seconds` could raise during learning, and invalid raw operation values could be persisted.
Delimiter characters inside a policy dimension could produce the same serialized context key as a different combination of dimensions.
A legitimate previous MAPE of zero was replaced with the new error by a truthiness fallback, exaggerating learned error after the next sample.
Invalid snapshot accuracy could become trusted after clamping; an `available` snapshot with no numeric visual score could crash feedback recording. Contradictory explicit trust flags were ignored.
Malformed stored feedback counters/history/EMA values could raise in recommendations or subsequent recording.
Per-context sample histories were limited, but the number of feedback contexts could grow without bound as strategies/settings changed.
Zero visual accuracy, coverage or confidence could disappear or be replaced by a positive secondary value in correction history.
Nonfinite/malformed calibration evidence could become high confidence, and an unexpected health-scoring exception was reported as nonblocking.
Final-canvas evidence with missing/invalid metrics or truthy non-Boolean flags could teach ETA calibration as a trusted completed draw.
Worker selection used machine CPU count even when the process could use only a restricted CPU set.
Linux available-memory estimates used free pages and ignored reclaimable memory, producing unnecessarily restrictive budgets.
One allocation probed CPU count and available RAM twice, so the budget and reported hardware could describe different moments.
Known available RAM below 128 MiB was rounded up to a larger planning budget; tuner recommendations could also exceed very low available memory.
The eight-row minimum and subsequent pressure scaling could override computed memory limits for wide images.
Python 3.12 executor `map` submitted every task eagerly, allowing a large pending-work allocation and unnecessary queued work after failure.
Explicit process mode with more than 61 Windows workers could fail at `ProcessPoolExecutor` construction.
The scheduler respected CPU mode for matrix work but still labeled correction scoring for GPU routing.
Invalid persisted scheduler schemas, worker counts, engine names or benchmark scores could crash selection or enter runtime recommendations.
Default recommendation loading reconstructed the machine signature from the stored CPU count, allowing an old CPU capacity to validate itself.
`run_auto_tune(save=False)` still called the scheduler benchmark with `save=True`.
A structurally shallow tuner cache check could load invalid CPU counts and unsupported planning/RAM/engine selections into the UI.
After a hardware benchmark error, the tuner loaded a cached profile without checking it against current hardware.
Explicit profiler stop tokens left active marks behind and repeated stops could double-count a phase.
An all-zero or unknown-only profile reported the first known phase as a bottleneck despite having no positive measurement.
Execution telemetry copied every path in a color group at once and allocated a slice for each pairwise distance traversal.
Known target lookups eagerly constructed unused fallback objects, and immutable classification sets were rebuilt repeatedly.
The bounded source probe copied a full-size RGB image before reducing it to at most 128 pixels on its long edge.
Cancellation arriving during source color analysis did not prevent the next probe or publication of source features.
Missing, negative or nonfinite projected time became zero, allowing a timed plan to pass the deadline gate.
Invalid quality thresholds defaulted to zero, while out-of-domain percentage metrics could pass acceptance.
The signing walk could follow a native-file symlink and pass an external target to SignTool.
Mixed file drops and clipboard file lists continue past unsupported files to find the first usable image.
Bound raw drop input, total item characters and item count before filesystem/regex processing; scan HTML/URL candidates without retaining all matches.
Interpret `file://localhost` as a local path instead of a UNC share.
Reject decoded control bytes in file URLs before filesystem use.
Switching preview tabs lays out only the changed pages; selecting the visible page avoids a redundant layout.
Reject duplicate or blank preview page names before allocating widgets and orphaning pages.
Contain Tk errors from destroyed CustomTkinter scroll targets.
Reuse existing profile presets without constructing a discarded generic preset on every lookup.
Protect shared profile preset defaults from caller mutation while returning an editable export copy.
Handle malformed optional calibration metadata when producing profile warnings.
Honor an explicitly supplied empty calibration state rather than falling back to stale state inside options.
Treat a warning string as one warning instead of rendering each character as a warning.
Preserve elapsed time when updating the same start state and use one clock snapshot for watchdog output.
Logging failures cannot interrupt valid start transitions or bypass invalid-transition rejection.
Require an actual supported integer calibration-anchor schema version.
Validate stored and translated calibration coordinates against signed Windows LONG bounds while retaining negative monitor coordinates.
Reject invalid layout tolerances consistently instead of truncating fractional tolerances or raising overflow errors.
Read only the version-history viewer's bounded character budget.
Try a readable bundled version-history fallback when the preferred existing file is inaccessible.
Bound dictionary bytes during the read, including files that grow between metadata inspection and reading.
Index immutable dictionary snapshots by letter count and reuse them across searches without stale results after caller list changes.
Keep native paste behavior in multiline text and spinbox controls, including Tcl widget path events.
Block clipboard imports while closing or waiting for a clear operation, preserving the in-flight operation's image state.
Apply EXIF orientation exactly once to pasted image objects without changing the clipboard source.
Recognize uppercase HTTP schemes and reject malformed hosts/ports before starting an image-fetch worker.
Roll back all worker startup stages, including hide/busy/thread-construction failures, while preserving the original error if cleanup also fails.
Respect cancellation that arrives before a non-screen worker begins its task.
Yield the UI event loop after a 15 ms drain budget instead of processing up to 250 expensive events in one uninterrupted call.
Contain canvas destruction during the preview error-message fallback itself.
Copy the mobile-preview URL without creating an unused Tk StringVar for every call.
Encode GIF recordings to a unique staging file, flush before atomic replacement, and preserve existing recordings on failure.
Close captured and quantized recording frames after success or partial capture failure.
Sample long safety-preview paths before coordinate conversion instead of allocating a transformed copy of every point.
Check preview cancellation before allocation, inside long individual paths and before returning completed layers.
Reuse the correctly composited source when preview dimensions already match, avoiding duplicate resizing and alpha compositing.
Skip nonfinite fill-region boxes without discarding otherwise valid auxiliary preview layers.
Commit a recaptured tool window identity only after anchor layout validation succeeds.
Keep subject-selector thumbnail bounds positive on compact desktops.
Destroy the subject-selection modal before invoking the application callback, including callbacks that raise.
Restore an initially minimized region-picker owner to its minimized state instead of leaving it withdrawn.
Release region-picker full-desktop buffers on selection/cancellation while leaving the delivered crop usable.
